prompt: Photorealistic side three-quarter view from slightly below at midspan of a steel footbridge, showing hidden under-deck tuned mass damper cassette in operating condition. Two long existing grey steel longitudinal girders run horizontally under an unchanged walking deck with parapet; a small pedestrian silhouette walks on deck to indicate live load. Spanning between the bottom flanges is a galvanized transverse cross-beam held by dark friction beam clamps gripping the flanges with no drilling. Bolted centrally below the cross-beam hangs a compact galvanized support frame cassette. Inside the cassette a large dark steel rectangular 800 kg block mass is suspended with visible vertical clearance, carried on two vertical steel coil springs on the sides and a central vertical viscous damper cylinder. The mass is shown mid-stroke, slightly displaced, free to move vertically while frame is fixed. Below the unit a light-grey color-matched perforated metal soffit screen with small holes and shadow gap covers the bottom, with the front half neatly cut away to make the interior mass, springs and damper fully visible. Real materials: painted steel, galvanized steel texture, perforated sheet, concrete deck edge. Bright overcast daylight, product-shot clarity, sharp focus on clamp, beam, frame, springs, damper and mass connections, correct relative sizes, no text, no labels, no arrows, no scale bars.
must_not: text labels or captions of any kind
cut deck or parapet or deck construction work
extra masses or extra dampers beyond one unit

Moving mass centered, fixed structure above and shroud below.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Bridge in service under pedestrian walking causing vertical bounce; tuned mass oscillating vertically out of phase on springs while damper strokes, dissipating energy, fixed frame steady and mass free.
